cim: Make an AI Short Film in Claude | Runway MCP
cim_eredeti: Make an AI Short Film in Claude | Runway MCP
szoveg_eredeti:
Access the prompts and project setup: https://runway.com/prompts/short-film-runway-mcp

Learn how to make a complete micro film using Claude and the Runway MCP. We set up a Claude project with director’s notes, develop the story and storyboards, build character and location references, then turn it all into a four-scene shot list with consistent look notes. From there we use the burst method to generate coverage references, create full multi-shot scenes in draft mode and bring everything into the edit.

Chapters:
00:00 Intro
00:40 Setting up a Claude project
01:40 Planning and storyboards
02:30 Character and location references
04:00 Shot list and the burst method
05:15 Generating and editing the scene
